entry_conditions: Drawer is open and stable; block is low in the tunnel; target_pose is the intended drawer destination; gripper is open at normal entry or closed only when TCP remains near a plausibly held block.
exit_conditions: Observed object is outside the tunnel, above world z 0.16 m, moving with TCP under closed fingers, and destination-relative commands have begun transfer toward the open drawer.
overlap_role: All actions 300:840 remain supervised. The 300:440 overlap supports starts during retreat/approach; 680:840 covers clearance, reorientation and transfer shared with placement.
successor_readiness: The guard is inactive after observed clearance. Hand off during 680:840 once object/TCP coupling persists above 0.16 m and destination-directed transfer has begun; closed fingers alone are insufficient.
failure_signatures: Closed fingers without object/TCP coupling, guard repeatedly projecting requested +x motion while the block remains low, failure to rise, object drop, destination drift, or persistent IK nonconvergence/limits.
continuation_guidance: Continue low negative-x extraction and lift before destination transfer. If the block itself is reliably displaced, prefer h01; if a valid unusual predecessor TCP is the main issue, prefer h02.
limitations: No contact truth or demonstrated retry supports failed-grasp recovery. The conservative guard is proxy-based, does not prove collision freedom, and may reject an unseen but valid below-clearance maneuver.
